description: Walk forward to a pickup zone, acquire a carried object (modelled as co-located with the torso on this planar biped), then carry it to a drop zone. Success when the torso reaches the drop zone within the step budget after passing the pickup zone.
Hold the current pose; no forward motion. Always succeeds when paid, and proves the bounded / interruptible policy (the run terminates cleanly and never settles a failed action).
